description: Compares the annual running cost of an electric car against a petrol/diesel car in Cyprus, splitting charging between spare solar production, home grid electricity and public chargers, and reporting yearly savings and payback on the extra purchase cost. Use to compare EV and petrol/diesel running costs. Ask for actual annual distance, vehicle consumption, fuel price, charging shares and tariffs for each active charging source; when solar charging is selected, require available spare solar production. Reuse supplied facts and ask only for missing essentials. Omitted extra purchase cost means no payback estimate.

evConsumption.description: EV consumption in Wh per km (e.g. 170).

evInsurance.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

evOther.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

evRoadTax.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

extraEvCost.description: Extra purchase cost of the EV versus the petrol/diesel alternative, EUR.

fuelPrice.description: Fuel price in EUR per litre.

gridElectricityPrice.description: Home electricity price in EUR per kWh.

homeGridShare.description: Share of home charging drawn from the grid, percent.

iceConsumption.description: Petrol/diesel consumption in litres per 100 km.

iceInsurance.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

iceOilChange.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

iceOther.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

iceRoadTax.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

iceService.description: Annual servicing cost of the petrol/diesel car, EUR.

projectionYears.description: Horizon of the cumulative savings series (default 10).

publicChargingPrice.description: Public charging price in EUR per kWh.

solarDirectShare.description: Share of home charging covered directly by solar, percent.

spareSolar.description: Spare solar production available for charging, kWh per year.
